Description.Name: Upgraded M.A.S.H.
Description.Details: Despite the technological collapse following the Succession Wars, some of the M.A.S.H. equipment has become quite obsolete since the Star League era. Replacing it with modern analogs will increase the efficiency of the mobile surgical hospital and, accordingly, the chances of wounded MechWarriors to survive.

AssignedCastDescription: We have a really good M.A.S.H. and the MedTechs are pretty pleased with it, but it makes sense to replace some of the hardware, Commander. Not that it is unreliable, but there are more efficient and up-to-date models.
